properties.description: As built (2026-09-17): closure_report sums five computations that already exist — requirement_is_delivered per live requirement, budget_report per Constraint with a limit (against a declared margin when one is stated), seam_coverage, the scheduled work still governed by a proposed decision, and the quantity provenance sweep the detector shares — into one read. Each leg reports swept, closed, share, a swept_note in words and its worst offender; a counted leg that swept nothing carries closes: None and the design does not close on it, with the hole saying 'nothing to run on'. The criterion is Project.closure_legs and Project.closure_threshold, declared with set_closure_criterion (validated against the five legs, 0–100, no default); first_hole is the first leg in the DECLARED order that fails. No declaration reads no_closure_criterion_stated with the legs still shown. closure_criterion_undeclared asks once on a design with live requirements. release_report carries a ClosureSummary beside its own answer — a report, never a gate. Constraint.margin is read by the budgets leg; budget_report's verdict is against the bare limit.
properties.name: A closure report: five legs, what each swept, the first hole, and a verdict against the declared threshold
